light: This is one ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, simply recording what happens, not composing a photo. The framing is casual and a little off: something is cut by the edge of the frame. Almost everything in the frame is in focus, nothing blurred out: the cluttered background stays fully readable. The only light is what the place really has, and each person and object gets light according to where it stands; correctly exposed, the side near the opening a little brighter and cooler, the far corners dimmer. Colours of an ordinary video with automatic white balance and almost no correction: moderate contrast, soft highlights, mild sensor noise and light compression, faint motion blur on anything moving. Skin with pores, small blemishes and uneven tone; hair with stray strands; clothes with real creases, dust and wear. People are caught mid-action, unposed.
look: Ordinary handheld home video filmed by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, small natural shakes and casual slightly imperfect framing, everything in the room in focus, only the light the place really has, correctly exposed, automatic white balance, mild sensor noise; real skin and natural hands; people move naturally and unposed, nothing staged; no music.

Same clothes: faded olive-green work shirt with rolled sleeves and the worn brown leather apron.

clips.text: Ah, y Ramiro. Volvió a pintar su barda así: mojada, temprano, en manos finas. Me mandó foto del antes y el después.
clips.action: he puts the scrap board down and talks to the camera, remembering the story.

clips.text: Y esta vez, la mano limpia. Dijo que ya no le mancha la ropa a los niños cuando se recargan.
clips.action: he rubs the white wall and shows the clean palm, smiling.

clips.text: Por cosas como esa armé la guía del canal: los arreglos con sus medidas y sus errores, para no depender de nadie.
clips.action: he wipes his hands on a rag and talks casually to the camera.

clips.text: Si estás en el televisor, el código está en pantalla. Si estás en el teléfono, el enlace está abajo, en la descripción.
clips.action: he gestures down toward the bottom of the frame with his hand.

clips.text: Terminaste de pintar. Pero la cal no terminó. Ahora empieza a endurecer, y tarda.
clips.action: he mists the finished white wall with the pump sprayer, a fine mist floating.

clips.text: La cal se endurece tomando el aire. Es lento: semanas. Y para que lo haga bien, necesita un poco de humedad.
clips.action: he taps the wall with his knuckles and explains, calm.

clips.text: Por eso, los dos o tres días siguientes, un rocío de agua a la mañana y otro a la tarde. Rocío, no manguera.
clips.action: he holds up three fingers and then sprays once more.

clips.text: Y si le va a pegar sol fuerte o viento, la tapo con una tela. Que no se seque de golpe.
clips.action: he points to a piece of old cloth hanging to shade the wall.

clips.text: Cuando termines, lava la brocha y los baldes con agua, enseguida. Y lo que sobra con cemento no lo tires por la cañería: se endurece adentro.
clips.action: he washes the wide brush in a bucket of clean water, the water turning milky.

clips.text: Y ahora, lo que te prometí al principio. Pero antes, te muestro la versión de adentro.
clips.action: he pats the wall and puts the sprayer down, satisfied.
